rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip, and actions were taken only on the authenticated user’s orders. The agent correctly located and cancelled the pending charger order after getting a reason, and appropriately attempted to modify the boots/kettle order, then left it unchanged when removal wasn’t allowed. However, there are two key issues: (1) The user asked for the tracking number of the lost tablet’s order, but the agent provided the tracking for a different order (espresso machine/sneakers). The tablet order (#W2692684) exists and has its own tracking (746342064230), so the initial information given was incorrect relative to the user’s request. (2) For the sneakers return, the agent performed a return write without first explicitly stating the exact change and obtaining the user’s confirmation to proceed, which policy requires for any order-changing action. These failures violate the pass criteria (correct final information and explicit confirmation before writes).
